title: dracaena neobella
intro: Dracaena neobella, commonly known as the "Copper Dragon" or "Neon Robusta", is a species of flowering plant in the asparagus family, characterized by its striking copper-colored stems and dark green, lance-shaped leaves. The plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including air purification and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as asthma and allergies. The therapeutic actions of Dracaena neobella include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and boost the immune system due to its adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
